Click elsewhere in a row to see the recipe, how to learn it and what that costs, and where each reagent price comes from. Profit is per craft, after the auction house cut, using whichever is better: selling on the AH or to a vendor.

How costs are calculated

Leave "free herbs" off to see the real opportunity cost. If crafting doesn't beat selling the raw herbs on the AH, crafting isn't worth it.
